notes.title: Added Minigames Mode
notes.content:
Added Minigames mode - currently contains 2 minigames which can be unlocked after beating certain levels of the main game.

1. RGB Invaders - Survive endless waves of enemies and defeat as many enemies as possible. Unlocked after beating level 40.

2. Laser Phaser - Survive endless waves of lasers (and enemy projectiles) for as long as possible. Unlocked after beating level 50.
